parameters.help_en:
The file system ID.

CPFS: The ID must start with `cpfs-`, such as cpfs-099394bd928c****.

CPFS for Lingjun: The ID must start with `bmcpfs-`, such as bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****
parameters.help_zh:
文件系统ID。

CPFS：必须以`cpfs-`开头，例如cpfs-099394bd928c****。

CPFS智算版：必须以`bmcpfs-`开头，例如bmcpfs-290w65p03ok64ya****
parameters.name: file_system_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run for this delete request.

A dry run checks parameter validity and inventory without actually deleting the instance.

Valid values:

true: Sends a dry run request without deleting the instance. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, whether the request format is valid, and whether business constraints are met. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check passes, HTTP status code 200 is returned.

false (default): Sends a normal request. After the check passes, the instance is directly deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否对此次删除请求执行预检。

预检操作会帮助您检查参数有效性、校验库存等，并不会实际删除实例。

取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会删除实例。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回200 HttpCode。

false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接删除实例
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may vary for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性，从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同的请求间该参数值唯一。

ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25693.html。

若用户未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
